concept: Decentralized work bounty platform where sponsors fund tasks with GEN, hunters submit solutions, and AI consensus evaluates quality to release payment and build reputation
deploymentConstraints: StudioNet (chain 61999) is gasless and accepts native value locks from zero-balance accounts
Use emit_transfer for GEN payments on finalized state
Quick wallet (genlayer-js createAccount) is the primary signing path; MetaMask unreliable on StudioNet

uniquenessCheck.distinctDomain: Work marketplace with value transfer and reputation
uniquenessCheck.distinctMechanism: Bounty posting with GEN escrow, AI quality evaluation of submissions, automated payment release, hunter reputation tracking

palette.notes: Deep charcoal with warm amber accent, muted bone text, dark slate panels

gateNotes: Concept is distinct in domain (work marketplace vs debate/compliance/review), visual direction (dark cargo terminal vs all prior), and mechanism (value transfer bounties vs all prior)
